data.description:
## Symptom
check-recipe-engines.sh wildcard engine case uses 'command -v ts-morph' which always returns non-zero because ts-morph is an npm library, not a CLI binary. Any sprint task list containing a TypeScript recipe tag (recipe:normalize-imports or recipe:add-parameter) will always report MISSING_ENGINE: ts-morph even when ts-morph is properly installed via npm.

## Root Cause
The wildcard case in the engine check switch (check-recipe-engines.sh:116-121) checks binary presence only. ts-morph needs node + require('ts-morph/package.json') for detection.

## Expected Behavior
ENGINES_OK when ts-morph is installed as an npm package accessible to node.

## Actual Behavior
MISSING_ENGINE: ts-morph always, blocking sprint preflight for TypeScript recipes.

## Fix
Add a ts-morph) case that: checks node availability, uses node -e require detection, and compares version with _version_gte.
data.title: check-recipe-engines.sh: ts-morph detected with command -v instead of node require
